attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Dexterity, or Melee skill + 1d8+3; you may additionally recharge a blessing to add your Dexterity die, and you may additionally recharge this card to add another 3d6 and the Force trait. If the check is against a bane that has the Demon trait, add another 3d8. If you do not have the Monk trait, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.
